fields.claim: Several street lights on the East Ward main street were dark on weekday evenings.
fields.uncertainty: I did not count every light.
fields.what_observed: A row of lights was dark between the bus stop and the market on three evenings.
fields.how_observed: Walked the main street on three evenings and noted the dark lights.

fields.claim: Shop owners on the main street lose evening customers when the street is dark.
fields.uncertainty: I only spoke to a few shop owners.
fields.group: Shop owners on the East Ward main street
fields.concern: Customers stop coming after dark when the street is unlit.
fields.what_would_help: Lights that work until closing time.

fields.claim: Repair requests for street lights get no reply for several weeks.
fields.uncertainty: I do not know how long other requests take.
fields.pattern_illustrated: Repair requests take weeks to get any reply.

fields.claim: My household is owed an apology because nobody ever answered our own repair request.
fields.uncertainty: I do not know what happened to other requests.
